sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Apartments"."building_id" AS e, SUM("Apartments"."room_count") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("Apartments"."bedroom_count" - "Apartments"."bathroom_count") AS REAL) / "Apartments"."bathroom_count")) AS m2 FROM "Apartments" GROUP BY "Apartments"."building_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
